enrollment_suspension_check.name: enrollment_suspension_check
enrollment_suspension_check.value: "enrollment"."suspended_at" is not null or ("enrollment"."suspended_reason" is null and "enrollment"."suspended_by" is null)

entitlement_revocation_check.name: entitlement_revocation_check
entitlement_revocation_check.value: ("entitlement"."revoked_at" is null and "entitlement"."revoked_reason" is null and "entitlement"."revoked_by" is null) or ("entitlement"."revoked_at" is not null and "entitlement"."revoked_reason" is not null)

inbox_event_lease_check.name: inbox_event_lease_check
inbox_event_lease_check.value: ("inbox_event"."state" = 'leased') = ("inbox_event"."lease_owner" is not null and "inbox_event"."lease_until" is not null)

media_asset_ready_check.name: media_asset_ready_check
media_asset_ready_check.value: "media_asset"."state" <> 'ready' or ("media_asset"."sha256" is not null and "media_asset"."size" is not null and "media_asset"."content_type" is not null and "media_asset"."confirmed_at" is not null)

outbox_message_lease_check.name: outbox_message_lease_check
outbox_message_lease_check.value: ("outbox_message"."state" = 'leased') = ("outbox_message"."lease_owner" is not null and "outbox_message"."lease_until" is not null)

panel_banner_link_check.name: panel_banner_link_check
panel_banner_link_check.value: "panel_banner"."link_url" is null or char_length("panel_banner"."link_url") between 1 and 500

panel_banner_window_check.name: panel_banner_window_check
panel_banner_window_check.value: "panel_banner"."starts_at" is null or "panel_banner"."ends_at" is null or "panel_banner"."ends_at" > "panel_banner"."starts_at"

video_provider_connection_secret_check.name: video_provider_connection_secret_check
video_provider_connection_secret_check.value: ("video_provider_connection"."ciphertext" is null) = ("video_provider_connection"."nonce" is null) and ("video_provider_connection"."ciphertext" is null) = ("video_provider_connection"."key_version" is null)
